coverage: All active PAGASA General Flood Advisories intersecting Luzon or Cebu

advisories.message:
Under present weather conditions, At 3:00 PM today, the center of the eye of Super Typhoon "ROSAL" {CHAMPI} was estimated based on all available data at 750 km East of Aparri, Cagayan (18.8°N, 128.7°E) with maximum sustained winds of 205 km/h near the center and gustiness of up to 250 km/h. It is moving West Northwestward at 25km/h.  
The 12-hour rainfall forecast is light to moderate rains and thunderstorms.  
WATERCOURSES LIKELY TO BE AFFECTED :  

 + **Cagayan** - Rivers and its tributaries particularly Linao, Lower Abulug, Lower Pamplona, Cabicungan, Aunugay, Baua, Palawig and Taboan.  
 + **Batanes** - All rivers and its tributaries  
 + **Isabela** - Rivers and its tributaries particularly Dikatayan, Divilacan and Palanan-Pinacanauan.
advisories.instruction: People living near the mountain slopes and in the low lying areas of the above mentioned river systems and the **Local Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Councils** concerned advised to take necessary precautionary measures.
